name: sv-formatter
description: Structure-driven SystemVerilog formatter: indentation derived from the parse tree, column alignment, macro-safe, and idempotent.

systemverilogFormatter.indentSize.description: Number of spaces per indentation level. Ignored when useTabs is true.
systemverilogFormatter.indentSize.markdownDescription: 每级缩进的空格数。`useTabs` 为 `true` 时此项被忽略。

systemverilogFormatter.useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.
systemverilogFormatter.useTabs.markdownDescription: 用 Tab 缩进，而不是空格。

systemverilogFormatter.explodePortList.description: Put each module port on its own line.
systemverilogFormatter.explodePortList.markdownDescription: 模块端口列表一行一个端口。

systemverilogFormatter.explodeDeclaratio.description: Put each declared signal on its own line, repeating the full type prefix (wire a, b; becomes two wire declarations).
systemverilogFormatter.explodeDeclaratio.markdownDescription: 多信号声明拆成一行一个，每行重复完整类型前缀（`wire a, b;` → 两行 `wire` 声明）。

systemverilogFormatter.explodeInstancePo.description: Deprecated: set instanceLayout to "off" instead. When false, instance text is left untouched.
systemverilogFormatter.explodeInstancePo.markdownDescription: **已废弃**，请改用 `#systemverilogFormatter.instanceLayout#` 设为 `off`。此项为 `false` 时例化原文不动。

enumDescriptions: 每个连接一行，`.port(expr)` 各列对齐。端口多、要逐个确认连线方向时用。
整个实例压成一行，同模块相邻实例的 `.port(expr)` 列对齐成表。适合成批的小端口实例。
连接数 ≤ `compactInstanceMaxPorts` 用 compact，超过则 explode。
systemverilogFormatter.instanceLayout.markdownDescription:
模块例化（instance）端口连接的排版方式。

- `explode` —— 每个连接一行，`.port(expr)` 各列对齐。端口多、要逐个 review 连线时用。
- `compact` —— 整个实例压成一行，同模块相邻实例的 `.port(expr)` 列对齐成表。适合成批的小端口实例。
- `auto` —— 连接数不超过 `#systemverilogFormatter.compactInstanceMaxPorts#` 时用 compact，超过则 explode。日常最省心。
- `off` —— 保持源码原样，不重排例化（例外：列表里有独占一行的指令时仍走 explode，否则指令会被折进一行）。

连接列表里含注释、或 `` `ifdef `` 独占一行时**强制走 explode**：折成一行会吃掉注释，或让指令不再独占一行（预处理只识别行首指令）。

> 只想对**某一次选中**改用别的布局，用 `Ctrl+Alt+L`（Format Selection with Layout），
> 它按本次调用覆盖该项，不改动 `settings.json`。

systemverilogFormatter.compactInstanceMa.description: Port count up to which instanceLayout "auto" picks the compact layout.
systemverilogFormatter.compactInstanceMa.markdownDescription: `instanceLayout` 为 `auto` 时的判定阈值：连接数不超过该值用 compact 布局，超过则 explode。

systemverilogFormatter.alignPortsInHeade.description: Align the direction, type, width and name columns of module ports and declarations.
systemverilogFormatter.alignPortsInHeade.markdownDescription: 对齐模块端口与声明的方向、类型、位宽、名称列。

systemverilogFormatter.alignDeclarationT.description: Align the trailing ; and , of consecutive declarations.
systemverilogFormatter.alignDeclarationT.markdownDescription: 对齐连续声明行尾的 `;` 与 `,`。

systemverilogFormatter.alignConsecutiveA.description: Align the assignment operator of consecutive assignment statements.
systemverilogFormatter.alignConsecutiveA.markdownDescription: 对齐连续赋值语句的赋值运算符。

systemverilogFormatter.alignConsecutiveD.description: Align the declared names of consecutive declarations.
systemverilogFormatter.alignConsecutiveD.markdownDescription: 对齐连续声明中的变量名。

systemverilogFormatter.spaceAroundBinary.markdownDescription: 二元运算符两侧加一个空格。

systemverilogFormatter.maxConsecutiveBla.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines to keep.
systemverilogFormatter.maxConsecutiveBla.markdownDescription: 最多保留几个连续空行。

systemverilogFormatter.ensureTrailingNew.description: Ensure the file ends with exactly one newline.
systemverilogFormatter.ensureTrailingNew.markdownDescription: 确保文件以恰好一个换行结尾。

systemverilogFormatter.formatOnParseErro.description: Format even when the source has syntax errors. Off by default to avoid mangling incomplete code.
systemverilogFormatter.formatOnParseErro.markdownDescription: 源码有语法错误时仍然格式化。默认关闭——不完整的代码被重排后更难定位问题。

enumDescriptions: 在控制台打印每次格式化请求命中的块类型，排查插件自身问题时用。
systemverilogFormatter.trace.server.description: Trace formatting requests (for debugging the extension).
systemverilogFormatter.trace.server.markdownDescription: 输出格式化请求日志，用于排查插件本身的问题。设为 `messages` 会在控制台打印每次请求命中的块类型。

systemverilogFormatter.caseItemOnSameLin.description: Keep a case item whose body is a single simple statement on the label line (`2'd0: sel = 1'b1;`).
systemverilogFormatter.caseItemOnSameLin.markdownDescription: `case` 项的主体只有一条简单语句时，与标签留在同一行（`2'd0: sel = 1'b1;`）。

systemverilogFormatter.alignTerminatorMa.description: Give up on aligning the trailing `;` of a declaration group when the widest line is further than this many columns from the narrowest. 0 disables the limit.
systemverilogFormatter.alignTerminatorMa.markdownDescription: 一组成员中最宽行与最窄行相差超过该列数时，放弃对齐行尾 `;`，避免一个长表达式把整组推飞。`0` 表示不限制。

editor/context.when: editorLangId == systemverilog && editorHasSelection || editorLangId == verilog && editorHasSelection
